fnol_description: Supply hose behind the washing machine split and water spread across the laundry room and hallway.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Braided hose split at the crimp while the machine was running. Insured heard it and shut the valve within about 20 minutes. Laundry and hallway floors wet; drying contractor on site the same day.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate reviewed and agreed. No sign of earlier leaks, no mold.

fnol_description: Water stain on the kitchen ceiling under the upstairs bathroom.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Plumber opened the ceiling. Slow drip from the shower valve body. Staining rings and soft, rotted subfloor show the drip had been running for about three to four weeks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Insured says they noticed a faint stain roughly a month ago but assumed it was an old mark.

fnol_description: Pipe burst under the floor slab and water came up into the family room.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Leak detection found a break in the cold water line under the slab, north-east corner of the family room.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Structural engineer report received. The slab has dropped about 4 cm at the north-east corner because of soil subsidence after a sinkhole opened two houses away on 2026-05-28. Engineer concludes the line sheared because the slab moved.

fnol_description: Wind tore shingles off the roof during a storm and water came into the main bedroom.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: The storm on 2026-08-22 was Hurricane Delia, named by the National Hurricane Center on 2026-08-20. Shingles torn off over the main bedroom; rain came in through that opening. Roof is 9 years old.

fnol_description: Mold found behind the kitchen base cabinets after a dishwasher leak.

estimate_lines.item: Mold testing, removal and cabinet rebuild

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Dishwasher inlet line failed on 2026-07-10 and was found the same day. The water damage itself was settled on an earlier claim. This claim is for the mold only.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Insured started fans and a rented dehumidifier the same evening; rental receipt dated 2026-07-10 is on file. Mold found behind the base cabinets during tear-out on 2026-07-15.

fnol_description: Basement flooded with dirty water during heavy rain.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Water came up through the basement floor drain. The city confirmed a blockage in the municipal sewer main on the street that evening. No plumbing failure inside the house.

fnol_description: Engagement ring lost while travelling in Lisbon.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Insured noticed the ring was missing on return to the hotel. No sign of theft; hotel and restaurant searched. The ring is item 1 on the Valuable Articles Schedule.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Standing-seam metal roof. Many small dents across the south slope. No punctures and no water inside. Manufacturer's rep inspected and confirms no loss of service life.

fnol_description: Break-in at home; laptop and camera used for my photography business were stolen from the home office.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Police report filed. Laptop and camera are owned by the insured and used in the photography business they run from home. Insured also submitted a quote to recover client photo files from a backup drive.

fnol_description: Water dripping from the ceiling in the upstairs hallway.
